This notice describes how the public HeyDock website processes information when you browse pages or send an enquiry.

HOW WE HANDLE INFORMATION

What this website does.

Website operator

This website is operated for HeyDock. Company number: pending confirmation. Registered office: pending confirmation. Privacy contact: use the enquiry form.

Enquiry form

When you submit the contact form, HeyDock processes the details you provide (customer type, service interest, company, name, email, location, timing, budget indication and description) to respond to your enquiry. The lawful basis is steps toward a contract / legitimate interests in answering business enquiries. Fields are validated on the server. Enquiry text is sent by POST to a Cloudflare Pages Function and then to the configured email provider (Resend) for delivery to the monitored business inbox. Enquiry contents are not placed in page URLs and are not stored in browser storage by this site.

Email delivery provider

Resend processes enquiry messages for delivery. Configure RESEND_API_KEY, HEYDOCK_FROM_EMAIL and HEYDOCK_TO_EMAIL in the hosting environment only. Retention in the mailbox and provider dashboards follows those systems’ settings; purge or export requests can be made through the privacy contact channel above.

Hosting

Production hosting is intended for Cloudflare Pages. The platform may process technical request data under its own terms. This site does not add advertising trackers or analytics scripts.

Cookies and browser storage

The website code does not set tracking cookies or persist form entries. Catalogue filters operate within the current page.

Your rights

Depending on applicable law you may request access, correction, deletion or objection. Use the enquiry form and describe the request. Operator identity fields still marked pending must be completed before relying on this notice for a regulated launch.
